nodes.title: Invent reference 1: Griddle

widgets_values_named.prompt: Create one original fictional adult anime fighting-game character, with no image inputs and no resemblance to a real person or existing character. Griddle is a cheerful barbecue dad in his late forties: short broad powerful build, round face, warm brown skin, bald head, compact triangular auburn beard. Brick-red sleeveless utility apron ending above the knees over a cream short-sleeve shirt, navy work trousers, oversized orange heatproof wrist cuffs, dark brown ankle boots. No hat or handheld props. Full-body three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, relaxed boxing guard, visible friendly face, separated arms and legs, complete hands and shoes. Original 1990s shonen anime model art, bold ink and clean two-tone cel shading. One figure only, centered with generous padding, flat uniform chroma green RGB(0,255,0) background; no green on the character, shadows, lettering, labels, logos, grid, panels or watermark. This is a text-only fictional reference design, not a transformation of a photograph.
